content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm reviving this older thread to ask if anyone has worked with the latest version of [product_name] ([version_no]). I'm currently using Delphi and want to upload and start a program on the new [product_name] [article_no]. It seems that there have been some changes in the communication protocol. I'd really like to see this working too. I've been trying to communicate with libnodave and Delphi XE2 but haven't had any success yet.

analysis.insight_summary: Users aim to programmatically upload and start applications on the new [product_name] ([version_no]) hardware using Delphi, but encounter problems due to changes in the communication protocol. Existing tools and libraries, such as libnodave, are not working reliably with this updated hardware, leaving uncertainty over compatibility and causing frustration among developers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect either backward compatibility or updated protocol documentation so that older or third-party tools can continue functioning for uploading and starting programs. They seek verified solutions or guidance for working with Delphi in this context.
